items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: I also had my, my grandfather, my dad is there, and, uh, he's playing bass and drums.

ctx.x: Well, good enough, I got that filled in, uh, and it's the first reel.

Do you come from a musical family? That's right, uh, well, as you know, my father, uh, he's been around the business, that's all he's done for his life. And his life, he raised, uh, seven of us just playing. That's right. And, uh, I also had my, my grandfather, my dad is there, and, uh, he's playing bass and drums. Well, I wasn't born at the time, but, uh, I didn't get a chance to see him, no, but they was telling me he was pretty good. What was his name? Uh, I just, uh, you know, it started confusing, you know?…
